questions.text: Which of the following is appropriate for the definition of DFT?
options: A set of post-silicon techniques used to diagnose manufacturing defects without modifying the original design.
A design methodology that introduces structured test features to improve fault coverage, controllability, and observability while minimizing impact on functional performance.
A verification strategy focused on detecting functional corner-case failures through constrained-random simulation.
A physical-design-centric approach that improves yield by reducing process variation sensitivity.
A serial path of flip-flops active only in functional mode, used to observe internal nodes through primary outputs
A parallel structure inserted only for stuck-at testing and disabled during transition fault testing
A group of flip-flops driven by a dedicated test clock that bypasses functional clocks to avoid timing constraints

A serially connected set of scan-enabled sequential elements that, in shift mode, allows deterministic control and observation of internal states, while in capture mode behaves as functional registers

questions.text: Where to use a lock-up latch?
options: Between two flip-flops in the same clock domain to reduce combinational delay violations.
Between scan flip-flops belonging to different clock domains or clock phases to prevent race conditions during scan shifting.
At the output of combinational logic to improve observability during ATPG.
Inside clock-gating cells to maintain glitch-free clock operation during functional mode.

questions.text: Which of the following abstractions actually resembles the actual physical defect?
options: Single stuck-at fault model
Transition fault model
Bridging fault model
Path delay fault model

questions.text: Which of the following is true for the DFT cell library?
options: Contains only standard combinational logic cells
Includes special test-related cells such as scan flip-flops, test multiplexers, and clock-gating test cells
Used only during physical layout
Replaces standard cell library entirely
